Class UserDAO

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.db.UserDAO
public class UserDAO extends Object
Saves, loads and checks user accounts in the SQLite database.

Follows the DAO (Data Access Object) pattern: all SQL for the users table lives here, so the screens never touch the database directly. Passwords are always stored hashed via PasswordUtil.

    • register

      public User register(String username, String rawPassword, String email, String phoneNumber)
      Creates a brand-new account for the register page. The raw password is hashed (see PasswordUtil) before it ever reaches the database.
      Parameters:
      username - the new username
      rawPassword - the password as typed by the user
      email - the user's email address
      phoneNumber - the user's phone number
      Returns:
